lines.speaker: Uncle Sirisena
lines.text: Karu! Look at this! I just got this from the Patriots group. Official notice from the Elections Commission!

card.caption: CONFIRMED: EC changed voting hours
card.image_description: Screenshot of what appears to be an official Elections Commission notice. The header reads 'ELECTIONS COMMISSION OF SRI LANKA'. The logo is present but slightly wrong — the Sinha figure is on the wrong side. The footer is missing entirely. The notice states: 'URGENT NOTICE — Polling hours changed. Voting will begin at 4:00 AM due to security concerns. Please arrive before 4:30 AM. — Elections Commission'

lines.speaker: Uncle Sirisena
lines.prompt: 4am! We have to wake up very early. Shall I call your cousins?

choices.label: Share it. Better to be safe than miss voting.
"The EC logo looks wrong. And there is no footer. Let me check the notice board."
Look up the Elections Commission on your phone right now.
